column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 3 piece B's blocker, migration 018: all five tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) (newRunTestStore, already merged in piece 1), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases/workflow_payloads are PostgreSQL-only (the issue's own scoping decision, same as every piece-1-6d and child-workflow-gap-fix test), so none of the five has a MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all five skip here.
same five tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all five skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
